Package CPDFGeneration

Class CEmailBodySource

java.lang.Object
CPDFGeneration.CEmailBodySource
public final class CEmailBodySource extends Object
Owned snapshot identifying the selected primary email body, rather than every displayed multipart segment. Check status before reading its fields. Identifiers are opaque and meaningful within the originating result only. This snapshot remains valid after the result is closed.
Since:
1.3.0
